title: Minimum Deletions To Make String Balanced
description:
A string over `a` and `b` is balanced when no `b` appears before an `a`. Return the minimum number of characters to delete to make `s` balanced.

## Examples

```text
Input: s = "aababbab"
Output: 2
```

```text
Input: s = "bbaaaaabb"
Output: 2
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= s.length <= 10^5`
- `s` contains only `a` and `b`.
